name: sms-send
description: Send an SMS text message to a person by their E.164 phone number via the office Telnyx DID. Use the contact's verified SMS (or phone) number from contact-lookup — display names are not trusted for SMS identity. 1:1 only (no groups/MMS in v1). If Telnyx returns a carrier STOP (error 40300), treat the recipient as opted out and record a contact KG fact — do not retry.

inputs.context_bridge: string? (JSON — optional context bridge registration that adds a delegation hint so the agent can route any reply faster. Tracking is automatic but best-effort even without it: registration happens after the send and can fail, and what it registers expires — unless you set expires_in_hours, about 24 hours when this parameter is valid and about 6 hours when it is absent or malformed (malformed metadata is dropped silently and falls back to the bare-send window, so a typo here costs the longer window without telling you). A valid expires_in_hours replaces that default outright, in either direction: a smaller number gives a shorter window, not a longer one (a deployment may configure different defaults). Set expires_in_hours whenever the reply may land after that — anything the recipient will answer after a night, a weekend, or a trip. If the entry expired or was never registered, the reply arrives as an unrecognised cold inbound. Shape: {agent_id, expected_reply?, delegation_hint?, metadata?, expires_in_hours?}. Example: {"agent_id":"coordinator","delegation_hint":"calendar-specialist","expected_reply":"confirmation or reschedule request"})
